name: EOS 0.8 Review Fixes

on:
  push:
    branches: [eos/v0.8-program-adoption]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/eos-v08-review-fixes.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  fix-and-verify:
    if: github.actor != 'github-actions[bot]'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.12'

      - name: Apply reviewed controller corrections
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          from pathlib import Path
          path = Path('scripts/apply-eos-0.8-review-fixes.py')
          text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
          old = r'raise EosError("Adoption entity schema validation failed:\n- " + "\n- ".join(errors))'
          new = r'raise EosError("Adoption entity schema validation failed:\\n- " + "\\n- ".join(errors))'
          if old not in text:
              raise SystemExit('review patcher escape target not found')
          path.write_text(text.replace(old, new, 1), encoding='utf-8')
          PY
          python3 scripts/apply-eos-0.8-review-fixes.py
          python3 -m py_compile tools/eos/eos.py

      - name: Verify adoption safety review findings
        run: python3 scripts/test-eos-0.8-adoption-safety.py

      - name: Verify original EOS 0.8 adoption contract
        run: python3 scripts/test-eos-0.8-program-adoption.py

      - name: Verify canonical lifecycle model consistency
        run: python3 scripts/sync-eos-lifecycle-model.py

      - name: Verify EOS strictly
        run: ./scripts/eos verify --strict

      - name: Synchronize and verify machine documents
        run: |
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --write
          python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check

      - name: Commit reviewed corrections
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add tools/eos/eos.py machine .eos/trace-edges.tsv
          if git diff --cached --quiet --exit-code; then
            echo "No reviewed corrections remained to commit."
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m "fix(eos): address program-adoption review findings"
          git push origin "HEAD:eos/v0.8-program-adoption"
